name: Greater Strix
biography: Statistics of a manticore (Monster Manual), but Medium, a construct, and vulnerable to fire. Tail spikes are silver barbs loosed from its wings. Built by Baba Lysaga to hunt wereravens; fights to the death. Does not attack Ireena. Source: Arc C, C3.

items.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
items.description: The greater strix has twenty-four silver barbs. Used barbs regrow when it finishes a long rest.

items.name: Multiattack
items.description: The greater strix makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or three with its tail spikes.

items.name: Bite
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Claw
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Tail Spike
items.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. The barbs are silver, loosed in a volley from the strix's wings.
